historical_argon_verdict.classification: Historical verdict; not a fresh Argon review of the current 45-file manifest. Current acceptance is based on supervisor source review, executed regressions, browser probes, and recomputed hashes.

evidence_qualifications: The four motion receipts now execute saved agent stdout through a replay wrapper and rerun the behavioral verifier. They are not four fresh model-generation runs.
Token counts come from saved agent stdout; usage_source=agent_stdout_json_unattested and model/effort resolved remain unknown. cost_usd remains unknown.
lean-v2 saved generation stdout records 102.3512564 seconds and 37557 tokens; its 2672 ms receipt measures re-evaluation, not generation latency.

The original three artifacts exit early with unhandled_error because a drawer intercepts the desktop toggle click. Their failed outcomes are correct; this supervisor round does not attribute those exits to the later mobile_touch_close check.
The six baseline rows are two replay fixtures plus three failed original artifacts plus one accepted lean-v2 revision. They are not a valid four-trial estimate of general model quality.

39 of 43 artifact digest entries match at the declared paths. Four missing workspace replay-input aliases have the exact same digests as durable, present, hash-verified agent.stdout files; these bytes are retained, but the aliases themselves are not present.

45-file manifest verification is not a whole-repository fingerprint. The 175/182 unchanged accounting proves byte identity only for those 175 files. The seven overlapping changed files cannot have their historical hunks proved from a hash-only baseline.
The gate has 22 key revision paths, not the 19 stated in the handoff. Its source digest and the manifest aggregate were recomputed and match.
